verdict.rationale: Tavily documents an official MCP server that exposes the tavily-search and tavily-extract tools. The docs state it works with Cursor, Claude Desktop and any MCP client, and a probe confirmed the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, evidenced setup/auth/configuration details (local vs. hosted endpoint), and evidence that crawl/map/research are exposed via MCP beyond search and extract.
